relations.rationale: Booking the hall says nothing about the order in which people arrived.
Booking the hall is unrelated to whether traffic slowed Gus down.
Booking the hall does not bear on whether they packed up chairs together later.
If Leo showed up shortly after Mina, this doesn't specify Ben's arrival relative to Mina, though both describe near-Mina arrivals it's not directly linked.
Leo being in work boots is unrelated to him setting down folding chairs, though both describe Leo's actions they are independent facts.
Leo setting down chairs is unrelated to Gus apologizing for the delay.

Dev being slightly taller than Ben doesn't imply anything about whether they cared about height comparisons.
Height comparison is unrelated to Dev's shift preference.
Not caring about height comparisons is unrelated to liking evening shifts.
If Mina is on the same team as Leo, and Leo is on the same team as Dev, this supports Leo being linked to both, making the two claims consistent and mutually reinforcing.
Mina being on the same team as Leo doesn't affect whether the group discussed raised bed layouts.

If Mina is on the same team as Leo, and Leo is on the same team as Dev (per other claims), this would suggest Mina is on the same team as Dev, contradicting claim 18; but taken alone, claim 10 doesn't directly address Dev.
Mina being on Leo's team is unrelated to Dev's shift preference.
Team membership is unrelated to packing up chairs together.
Ben arriving a little later than Mina is consistent with and supports the idea that Ben arrived before Gus, since it doesn't preclude Gus arriving even later.
Ben arriving later than Mina doesn't establish that Gus arrived last overall.
Ben's arrival time relative to Mina is unrelated to the weather forecast.
Ben arriving before Gus supports the idea that Gus arrived last, as it's consistent with Gus being the final arrival.
